title: Great baskets
text: Great baskets. The baskets make my organization in my upright freezer so much better. Everything looks neat and I can easily shift things around.

product_metadata.title: 16inch Freezer Wire Storage Organizer Baskets, Household Refrigerator Bin with Built-in Handles for Cabinet, Pantry, Closet, Bedroom
features: Upgrade Freezer Baskets - Approximate Dimensions - 16in(L) x 10in(W) x 7in(H)，big capacity. Set of 4.
Quality Construction - Wire grid made of sturdy steel construction with PE coated(food safe), stable and rustproof. Lightweight but sturdy enough to hold a lot of things.

Convenience - This freezer wire storage basket with built-in handles for portability, just grab and go. The open wire spacing lets you see at-a-glance the item you want, not miss anything. Empty baskets can be stacked to save space.

Household Storage Solution - This organizer basket is also a great household organize solution at home - Great to maximize storage space in the bedroom, bathroom, laundry/utility room, nursery, playroom and garage; Store a large variety of household items - video games, toys, lotions, bath soaps, shampoos, conditioners, linens, towels, laundry needs, craft and school supplies more; Great for homes, apartments, condos, dorm rooms, RVs or campers.
Right size basket in freezer, still can lift it out when full. Perfect organizing and lifting out to get to the ones underneath.
description: * The food fall out when I open the freezer door. * I want to save my time and money not to buy food everyday, but i do not know how to organize the big quantity foods. * I leave a steak for 2 years in my mess freezer.
Perfect to organize your chest freezer and upright freezer

* It’s open enough to see inside for easy retrieval of an item but closed enough to hold your items securely. * The baskets are good size for freezer, and allow good air circulation, items are kept neatly together. * Quick in and quick out with handles. * Steel construction, sturdy but lightweight.
Great for pantry storage. Increased room by 50 to 100%

* Strong enough to hold household items like video games, toys, lotions, bath soaps, shampoos, conditioners, linens, towels, laundry needs, craft or school supplies, makeup and beauty supplies and more, in kithen, bathroom, bedroom, classroom, office. * Good enough to store your pet food and toys. * Take out for camping, outdoor shower. * The possibilities are endless!
